Plumbing for other tools

Usage: kit internal [options] <command>

Commands:
  cache-stats  Print cache statistics

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Output:
  How results are shown
  --color <auto|always|never>  When to colour the output [default: auto]

Global Options:
  -v, --verbose  Print more output

Run 'kit internal --help-all' to list all 2 commands, or
'kit internal <command> --help' for details.
